hero: Retro-poster hero: oversized stacked uppercase Bricolage headline ('KOSHARY, THE EGYPTIAN WAY.') with a green outline-and-gold-shadow second line, over a ruled eyebrow; below, copy left and a 4-tile photo mosaic right (real koshary close-up as the large tile, falafel / roasted chickpeas / lentil soup as small tiles) in a hard ink frame with offset shadow and a rotated tomato-red 'TAIF'S FAMOUS' stamp.
honesty_notes: No invented reviews, ratings, prices, awards, staff, founding year or numbers. Ratings shown are the verified ones (Evendo 3.9/1,941; TripAdvisor 4.2/15; Rehlat 4.0). 'Why locals choose' is built from the five verified review themes, not invented quotes. The guide line 'the most famous and largest Koshari restaurant in the Kingdom' is quoted as a guide description. Menu board uses generic serving types from the verified cuisine, not a verified dish list; 'Prices on request' appears once, in the menu section. Hours are not published — the site says 'Call for today's hours'. Delivery is not claimed — visitors are told to ask when they call. Address uses the Wikivoyage street; the TripAdvisor variant is recorded in research.json only. Gallery carries a note that photographs are illustrative food photography, not the restaurant's own dishes. Footer disclaimer is the only 'Design concept' wording; no 'demo'/'concept'/'mockup' wording elsewhere. Bilingual AR/EN with full RTL; Arabic business name verified from the Facebook page metadata (كشري البشوات).
